description: Who may call: a public record that resolves to yes/no for a caller at call time. Transcribed from connect docs/contract.md §2 (contract v2), which is canonical. Record key: the grant id (opaque, referenced by the invite link). World-readable — a grant must not name the grantee (contract §8). Matchers combine by OR across grants; manual revoke is deleting the record.

matcher.description: how a caller qualifies (tagged union, below)

devices.description: endpoint rkeys this grant authorizes; omit = all

matcher.description: An open tagged union keyed on `type` (contract §2). New matcher types append with no reshape, so `type` lists known values rather than a closed set. Which fields each variant requires is stated in the contract, not expressible here.

type.description: ticket — qualify by POSSESSION; mutuals — qualify by IDENTITY, a preset that names no one; registeredCallers — qualify by IDENTITY, an explicit list

secretHash.description: ticket: sha256(secret) as lowercase hex; the secret itself lives only in the invite link's fragment, never in any record

dids.description: registeredCallers: the callers' DIDs, stored plaintext in v2
